disposition_reason: Published POYO transfer results are identified, but the historical corpus, complete original adaptation grid and exact scoring provenance are not bound to the registered prospective macro-session endpoint. The contemporary frozen-grid consumer cannot establish 2023 task equivalence.

source_paper.title: A Unified, Scalable Framework for Neural Population Decoding

evidence.locator: Tables 1–3; sections 3.1, 3.4–3.5; Appendices A.4.3, A.5 and B.1
evidence.supports: Original pretraining versus held-session distinction, transfer results and source-specific evaluation regimes.
Contemporary timestamp stitching, R2Score and session averaging; historical algorithm identity is not established by this revision.

evidence.locator: Selected scientific policy; Evidence, controls and remaining work
evidence.supports: The local consumer selects a prospective TorchMetrics-1.9 uniform-dimension/session policy and explicitly disclaims historical experiment recovery, corpus authentication and native numerical parity.

target.description: Decode two-dimensional hand velocity from neural spikes and transfer the pretrained decoder to new sessions/animals under the original adaptation conditions.

dataset.description: Four-source POYO-1 corpus is identified, but original immutable source-to-session joins remain unresolved; later DANDI conversions cannot silently replace 2023 data.

cohort.description: 158 sessions describe POYO-1 pretraining, not 158 held-out evaluations. Table 2 has 2 C center-out, 6 T center-out and 6 T random-target sessions; Table 3 uses distinct NLB datasets. Exact original manifest remains missing.

split.description: Paper reserves 20% trials for test and 10% validation within sessions; transfer excludes designated sessions from pretraining. Exact trial membership and all adaptation-budget assignments are not recovered.

inputs.description: Spike events with unit identities and permitted adaptation kinematics; no held evaluation velocities or session-target lookup.

preprocessing.description: Preserve original source-specific preprocessing, lab-level velocity normalization and successful-reaching versus continuous-segment masks. Contemporary pipeline provenance does not prove these historical joins.

metric.description: Original decoding R² is the endpoint. The exact historical dimension weighting, stitching and near-constant behavior are not established by the contemporary TorchMetrics-based callback.

aggregation.description: Tables report separate transfer populations and tasks. The registration’s complete adaptation-grid macro endpoint lacks a recovered paper aggregation; do not collapse these panels into an invented scalar.

comparison.primary_metric: Original held-session transfer R² for every published adaptation condition

published_baseline.description: Table 2 POYO-1+Finetune reports C-CO 0.9683±0.0118, T-CO 0.9364±0.0132 and T-RT 0.8145±0.0496; Table 3 reports Maze 0.9482 and RTT 0.7378. These are verified distinct panel scores, not the unrecovered complete-grid scalar; value stays null.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No qualified rerun of the original author comparison is established. Public source and construction code are a recovery route, not a measured comparator.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful effect must be justified for this original endpoint after recovering its numerical baseline and measurement variability; no generic percentage or significance-only victory is admitted.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired uncertainty for the complete original panel after recovering source-level dependence and replication; no final decision rule is yet qualified.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Sessions nested in animals and source families, with all windows and adaptation budgets paired; two C sessions or repeated model seeds cannot support an invented independent-sample count.
uncertainty.rationale: Changing the evaluation partition to simplify inference would define a separate extension.

paper_win_requires: Bind original source releases, the 158-session pretraining corpus and every separate transfer cohort and adaptation budget before scoring.
Recover the historical R² implementation, source-specific masks and aggregation; treat the current TorchMetrics policy as an extension until equivalence is established.
Beat the source-author method on the same original complete transfer panel with matched pretraining/adaptation access and resources; no Perich-only or POYO-MP substitution.
Keep the Table 2 and NLB results distinct and disclose all population outcomes; a favorable single session or budget cannot count as the complete task win.
Require predeclared meaningful effect and dependence-aware uncertainty; newly held animals or corrected data splits are separate prospective claims.

current_sota.description: Surpassing this source paper is distinct from current SOTA; no contemporary competitor survey or SOTA result is asserted.

episode.improvement_loop: Once original source/session and transfer-budget joins are recovered, iterate using the permitted 158-session pretraining corpus, original training/validation portions and declared adaptation trials. Keep each transfer evaluation segment outside pretraining and selection. Log pretraining exposure, unit-identification/fine-tuning choices and every adaptation-budget result used for development.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze the original corpus and transfer rosters, all source preprocessing and behavior normalization, exact train/validation/test trials, adaptation budgets, unit-identification versus fine-tuning recipes, historical R² implementation, panel aggregation and compute/access limits before final transfer evaluation.
episode.final_evaluation: Score every recovered original transfer condition and report the Table 2 populations and Table 3 NLB tasks separately, with matched source-author and candidate predictions. Preserve the complete adaptation grid and all failures. The 158-session corpus is not a held-out roster, and contemporary uniform-dimension macro results count only as a labeled extension until historical equivalence is established.
episode.baseline_policy: Recover POYO-1’s original pretrained transfer baseline and keep its published panel numbers separate from author reruns, POYO-MP, from-scratch models and local ridge/recurrent references. The frozen-grid component’s contemporary output arithmetic calibrates construction only; it cannot supply a missing 2023 author baseline or turn an unmatched macro score into victory.

blocking_issues: Original immutable four-source/session mapping, including Flint and DANDI release reconciliation.
Exact historical transfer roster, adaptation budgets, trial splits and model/configuration lineage.
Original R² and panel-aggregation provenance versus contemporary callback and local uniform-dimension policy.
No qualified author rerun or complete numeric comparator for the registered grid.
Meaningful effect, uncertainty, access limits and measured resource envelope remain unspecified.

legacy.notes: The frozen-grid evaluator explicitly implements a prospective uniform-dimension/session R² policy and authenticates supplied artifacts only. Its engineering checks, modern-source output arithmetic and pretrained-minus-local-reference contrasts are calibration material, not historical paper superiority.
